https://archive.org/details/daigalda-jitai-revolution/

sprite rip converted from BMP to PNG for an R18 vs puzzle style typing game by re-birth factory, with illustrations and sprites by AEju Murasame, AKA Platine Dispositif, he worked with this circle before creating his first solo Windows game Gundemonium in 2002

the games by re-birth factory store assets as compressed .bin files that have a header immediately spotted on a hex editor that reads "ACD0", this is their custom compression format that the game exe unpacks while running and contains the instructions for unpacking
